protocol.compact_reader: integrated physical cells; packed legacy inner bits available but ignored
protocol.full_iq: distinct raw likelihood verified against canonical (T,residual) factorization
protocol.cache_and_candidate_visibility: all candidate decisions and predictive densities committed before first reveal
protocol.common_ambiguity_subset: old Full IQ smooth posterior in [0.1, 0.9]; evaluation only

round2_packet.m4_mapping: merge valid v0 radial codes 0 and 1 into v1 code 1; erased rows clear the tail

contract.query_utf8: 只根据已缓存的观测和候选窗口说明，在四个窗口中选择一个补充参考。揭示前提交窗口编号、H0与H1的先验概率及各自对该窗口的预测分布。只读取所选窗口一次，随后给出H0与H1的后验概率。
contract.matched_candidate_space: complex matched sum in declared capture units
contract.mixture_node_order: geometry index then receiver turn; 16 nodes per hypothesis

design.dev_lock: minimize realized post-reveal NLL on dev within each public family; lowest ID breaks ties
design.oracle_definition: retrospective best fixed candidate per public family and per endpoint
design.nearest_anchor: latest old timestamp, smallest candidate ID breaks ties

refpool.k1_reveal: one immutable acquisition per policy; exact duplicate and prior-ID invariance checked

paired_gate.interval_method: paired stratified t approximation, two-sided Bonferroni over all elementary contrasts
paired_gate.scope: independent synthetic mothers, fixed simulator and fixed physical reader; equal family weights
